summary: This directory provides the foundational testing infrastructure for the project. It centralizes the validation logic and verification tools necessary to ensure the reliability and correctness of core project analysis components through automated testing processes.
responsibilities: Verify the correctness of analytical operations
Validate expected outputs for given project inputs
relationships: Tests validate the logic implemented by the project analysis components.
The test suite acts as a quality assurance layer for analytical operations.
designDecisions: Co-location of tests with the source logic
